info.title: AgentPass Human API
info.description: Cookie-authenticated, tenant-qualified organization and membership management for the Web Console. All timestamps are RFC 3339 strings and all opaque identifiers are UUIDs. Session cookies are never returned in JSON; the session bootstrap response returns only an ephemeral CSRF token, and invitation tokens are never returned after creation. Responses never contain email addresses.

post.summary: Exchange a verified SIWC Console assertion for a human session
post.description: The hosted Console BFF calls the runtime path /api/auth/session after the platform has verified Sign in with ChatGPT (SIWC). The browser sends no upstream identity claim, Cloud bearer, or caller identity header. Cloud verifies the compact Ed25519 assertion, consumes its namespaced jti digest atomically, and resolves the active member and role from PostgreSQL using the asserted provider, subject, and organization context. This operation never redirects.
post.x-agentpass-identity-resolution: Resolve provider/subject/organization membership server-side; never accept member_id, membership_id, or role from the assertion or request body.

verification: Verify Ed25519 with the pinned kid before parsing identity fields.
Require exact configured issuer, audience, origin, provider, and UUID organization context.
Require iat and nbf to be current within the configured clock skew and exp to be no more than 60 seconds after iat.
Consume SHA-256(iss || U+0000 || aud || U+0000 || jti) exactly once in durable PostgreSQL before membership resolution.
Never trust authorization, member, role, or tenant selection from browser headers.

post.description: Starts the upstream identity authorization flow. This is the only unauthenticated Human API operation.
Completes upstream authorization and establishes the HttpOnly humanSession cookie.

get.summary: List organizations visible to the authenticated human
get.description: The authenticated identity is the tenant selector. Only active memberships of that identity are returned; an organization outside that set is never disclosed.

post.summary: Create an organization and its initial owner membership
post.description: The authenticated identity becomes the initial owner. The organization is the tenant root created by this request, so no organization_id path parameter exists yet.
post.x-agentpass-atomic-admin-audit-outbox: Create the organization, initial owner membership, immutable admin-audit event, and any notification/outbox intent in one transaction.

patch.x-agentpass-atomic-admin-audit-outbox: The rename, version increment, immutable admin-audit event, and outbox publication intent commit atomically; a response is not successful if any one is missing.

get.summary: Get an organization visible to the authenticated human
List active and revoked organization memberships

patch.description: The owner role may be assigned or removed only when the resulting organization still has an active owner. This invariant is checked under the organization membership lock.
patch.x-agentpass-final-owner-invariant: Never leave an organization without at least one active owner; reject the last-owner transition with last_owner_protected.
patch.x-agentpass-atomic-admin-audit-outbox: Role change, affected-session/capability revocation, immutable admin-audit event, and outbox publication intent commit atomically.

post.description: Removal is a revocation tombstone, not physical deletion. The final active owner cannot be removed.
post.x-agentpass-final-owner-invariant: Never leave an organization without at least one active owner; reject removal of the last active owner with last_owner_protected.
post.x-agentpass-atomic-admin-audit-outbox: Membership revocation, session/capability revocation, immutable admin-audit event, and outbox publication intent commit atomically.

post.description: Invitation roles are deliberately limited to admin, auditor, and viewer. An invitation can never grant owner. The response contains the random one-time token exactly once; the server stores only its hash. The token is not email-bound.
post.x-agentpass-one-time-token: Return the raw random token only in this response; never log, persist, list, or return it again.
post.x-agentpass-atomic-admin-audit-outbox: Invitation creation, token-hash persistence, immutable admin-audit event, and notification/outbox publication intent commit atomically.

post.description: Revocation is idempotent for the same request but cannot resurrect or mutate an accepted invitation.
post.x-agentpass-atomic-admin-audit-outbox: Invitation revocation, immutable admin-audit event, and outbox publication intent commit atomically.

post.summary: Accept an invitation using the authenticated identity and one-time token
post.description: Acceptance requires both a valid authenticated human session and possession of the random one-time token. The token is bearer possession proof only and is intentionally not bound to an email address; the authenticated identity becomes the member. A token is consumed atomically and cannot be reused.
post.x-agentpass-one-time-token: Accept exactly once; store only a digest and reject replay, expiry, revocation, or organization mismatch.
post.x-agentpass-final-owner-invariant: Invitation acceptance cannot remove or demote an existing owner; the organization must retain at least one active owner.
post.x-agentpass-atomic-admin-audit-outbox: Token consumption, membership creation, immutable admin-audit event, and outbox publication intent commit atomically.

humanSession.name: __Host-agentpass_session
humanSession.description: Opaque, rotated, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite session cookie. The server stores only a hash and resolves the authenticated identity server-side.

recentWebAuthn.name: AgentPass-Recent-Auth
recentWebAuthn.description: Operation-bound, server-verified recent WebAuthn authorization; freshness alone is insufficient and reuse is rejected.

ConsoleIdentityAssertion.name: agentpass-console-identity
ConsoleIdentityAssertion.description: BFF-only compact Ed25519 assertion. It is not a browser credential and must be rejected when supplied together with Authorization or any caller identity header. The header and payload are exact canonical JSON objects; no redirect_uri claim is accepted.

OrganizationId.name: organization_id
OrganizationId.description: Tenant identifier. Every organization resource lookup is qualified by this value; cross-tenant existence is not disclosed.

MemberId.name: member_id
MemberId.description: Member identifier, interpreted only together with organization_id.

InvitationId.name: invitation_id
InvitationId.description: Invitation identifier, interpreted only together with organization_id.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Session-bound CSRF token. Same-origin/origin checks remain required; this header is not authentication.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable per-operation retry key. Reusing it with a different canonical request is rejected with idempotency_key_reused.

ExpectedVersion.name: If-Match
ExpectedVersion.description: Expected resource version for optimistic concurrency. Send the quoted decimal version, for example "7". A stale value returns version_conflict.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque, versioned, authenticated keyset cursor bound to the resource kind and authenticated tenant/member scope. Clients must not inspect or modify it. A malformed, tampered, expired-format, cross-resource, or cross-scope cursor is rejected as invalid_request.

SessionBootstrap.description: The request body is exactly the empty JSON object. Identity, organization, member, role, nonce, and provider fields are forbidden in the body.

SessionBootstrapCreated.description: A short-lived opaque human session was issued.

Set-Cookie.description: Opaque __Host-agentpass_session cookie. The value is never returned in JSON and must be Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/, and have no Domain attribute.

IdentityAssertionUnauthorized.description: The assertion is malformed, has an untrusted signature or binding, is expired, or does not resolve to an active membership. The response is intentionally opaque.

OriginForbidden.description: The request Origin is not the exact configured HTTPS Console origin.

IdentityAssertionReplay.description: The signed assertion jti digest was already consumed. No session is issued.

SessionBootstrapUnavailable.description: The identity replay ledger or membership store is unavailable. The service fails closed and does not issue a session.

InvitationCreated.description: Invitation and its one-time token. The token is returned only once.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request or missing browser security header

Forbidden.description: Session lacks the required organization role

NotFound.description: Tenant or resource is not visible to this session

IdempotencyConflict.description: Idempotency key is reused with a different request or an incompatible in-flight result

InvitationConflict.description: Invitation token or state cannot be accepted

InternalError.description: Stable internal failure response; sensitive details are not disclosed

SessionBootstrapRequest.description: Exactly {}. All identity and tenant context comes from the BFF-only signed assertion and server-side membership lookup.

InviteRole.description: Owner is intentionally excluded from invitation roles.

expires_at.description: Short-lived expiry chosen by the server within its configured maximum.

AcceptInvitationRequest.description: The request deliberately has no email field. The authenticated humanSession identity, not an email claim, receives the membership.

one_time_token.description: Random, single-use bearer token returned by invitation creation.

InvitationCreatedResponse.description: The one_time_token is returned once and must be delivered through a protected channel. It is never returned by list, get, revoke, or accept responses.

one_time_token.description: Random token with at least 256 bits of entropy; only its server-side hash is durable.
